Bounded multi-thread combined class-pressure test reports maximum queue and reserved transient bytes and proves limits; execute one real M4 Metal operation under a Metal reservation when available. View/model pressure is synthetic; no actual view/model or physical VRAM claim.

Cooperative cancellation is observed at bounded work-chunk boundaries and releases the lease; measure request-to-effective-stop p50/p95/max on M4 under combined class pressure, without asserting an unapproved SLA or rollback.

Run exact local AGENTS commands, native Rust fmt/clippy/tests/build, selected Wasm, translation fingerprint and diff checks; exact-head CI/review; post-merge main CI and devguide live Goal/workspace checks.

risks: Only cooperative work can be stopped; an in-progress non-cooperative platform call cannot be preempted.
Resource manager byte reservations account for declared transient buffers only, not driver/VRAM/model-weight memory.
Browser view and model adapters remain separate integrations and are represented by synthetic class pressure in this task.

Performance SLA or rollback of external effects
